drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:run-a-linkedin-content-system row: input_schema and step buyer-questions with its submit shape); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:run-a-linkedin-content-system for my bakery consultancy: my posts are in posts/2026-q3.md, my talks in talks/podcast-1.txt, and my sales calls in calls/call-1.txt and calls/call-2.txt."
no_lists_because: The workflow keeps its voice profile, research desk rows and drafts through tools (tool:keep-a-profile, tool:keep-a-prospect, tool:draft-a-post) and names no list of its own in its words, input or steps.
instructions: 1. Put your own published posts, transcripts of you speaking and sales call transcripts in your files, and note the file names; get the LinkedIn destination id from tool:list-post-destinations and make a tracked landing page and project.

2. Say "Run workflow:run-a-linkedin-content-system" with posts, transcripts, call_transcripts, linkedin_account, landing_page and project; target_accounts, stalled_days (default 21) and min_score (default 80) are optional.

3. It builds your layered voice guide, mines the questions buyers asked on your calls, lists stalled deals and their objections, briefs the target accounts, and drafts one post per common objection where every claim names its evidence.

4. Each post is scored on the 100-point rubric (a claim without a named source blocks the post), you approve the ones that pass, and the AI sets them to go at their time; read the results with tracked conversions kept apart from influence.
